svg.title: QuizParty — Settings / dual orientation vector recreation
svg.desc: Original path-drawn recreation of the supplied cartoon settings reference. Left: 1920 by 1080. Right: 675 by 1200. All stage art, controls, flags and mascots are vectors. English labels and illustrative states follow the requested study.
